task: Fix a real Koala scope friction where TEST transcript delivery evidence is treated as product scope drift.
outcome: A TEST-phase story whose only new file is .koala/story/actives/B-xxxx/evidence/transcript-diff.md shows scope_contract_check without OUT_OF_SCOPE, session_brief does not say scope_contract_acknowledge is required, reviewer status remains fresh, and DONE pre-check can proceed to summary/delivery-check instead of forcing TEST back to DEV.
facts: B-bffc exposed the issue on 2026-06-02 when TEST transcript-diff.md triggered OUT_OF_SCOPE.
docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md already says command-generated lifecycle artifacts should not expand product scope.
scope_contract_acknowledge is intentionally unavailable in TEST phase, so classifier coverage is the correct path for TEST generated artifacts.
constraints: Do not add a blanket .koala/** exemption.
Do not allow arbitrary evidence/** files.
Do not weaken product source, docs, or test scope enforcement.
Do not remove delivery-check or reviewer scope binding gates.
